metadata.description: Claude Code plugins Omar Eid has shared, each one audited before it goes public

plugins.name: loop-manager
plugins.description: Runs an issue through a development loop of agents to a pull request: a critic writes a checkable goal, a builder works until a SubagentStop hook running the repo's own check (devloop.json) says done, three reviewers read the commit once, a person reviews, and an optimizer proposes one piece of guidance at the lowest rung that would have prevented the miss (a tip, a goal rule, a CLAUDE.md tenet, a skill step, or the check). Once, or paced by /loop.
